alternatives_rejected.reason: Regulated lending policy forbids granting credit with sub-1.15 DSCR

audit_narrative: Application denied under Rule 3: DSCR of 1.05 is below the non-negotiable floor of 1.15. Cashflow cannot absorb interest rate shocks. [Underwriting Memo: The borrower is highly leveraged with total liabilities of EUR 1,650,000 and EBITDA down 18 percent year over year, leaving existing debt service of EUR 200,000 covered only about 1.05 times by EBITDA before the requested EUR 850,000 facility is added. The offered collateral is depreciating used milling machinery whose EUR 900,000 estimate is subject to high depreciation, so the proposed loan should be declined or restructured with a lower advance rate, independent collateral appraisal, and verified existing debt balances.]
